annotations.title: LGA · Method of travel to work

description:
How working residents got to work: car as driver or passenger, train, bus, tram, ferry, bike, walking, working from home, and the share using public transport, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 8,800 suburbs and localities and 540 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/travel-to-work`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_employed, public_transport_count, public_transport_pct, car_as_driver_count, car_as_driver_pct, car_as_passenger_count, car_as_passenger_pct, train_count, train_pct, bus_count, bus_pct, ferry_count, ferry_pct, tram_or_light_rail_count, tram_or_light_rail_pct, taxi_or_ride_share_count, taxi_or_ride_share_pct, truck_count, truck_pct, motorbike_or_scooter_count, motorbike_or_scooter_pct, bicycle_count, bicycle_pct, walked_only_count, walked_only_pct, other_single_method_count, other_single_method_pct, two_methods_count, two_methods_pct, two_methods_with_train_count, two_methods_with_train_pct, two_methods_with_bus_count, two_methods_with_bus_pct, three_methods_count, three_methods_pct, worked_at_home_count, worked_at_home_pct, did_not_go_to_work_count, did_not_go_to_work_pct, method_not_stated_count, method_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
